transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?
I, um… I came because I’ve been hearing voices. Like someone’s right there in my studio, clear, saying my name… saying my work is being judged. But nobody’s there. The place is quiet.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled or that someone is trying to communicate with you in other unusual ways?

Not like… controlled, exactly. But I did feel like people were trying to get at me in other ways. I thought the other home-care agency, and some people from the library, were watching my paintings and my client papers… like they were trying to steal some chance that was supposed to be mine. People said it didn’t make sense, but I still felt sure.
Have these experiences with hearing voices or feeling like people are watching you happened even when you weren’t feeling particularly down or upset?

Yeah… I think so. There was a stretch after I wasn’t so keyed up anymore—my energy had dropped, and I was sleeping more normal—but the voices were still there. And I still felt like people were judging my work or keeping track of it. That went on for… a few weeks, I guess.
Have you ever experienced these voices or feelings of being watched for a period longer than a month without any significant changes in your mood, like feeling depressed or overly excited?

I don’t know if it was more than a month. There was a time after my energy came down and I was sleeping more normal… the voices were still there, and I still felt like people were judging or tracking my work. It went on several weeks, I think.

Can you tell me more about how people were watching or tracking your work? Did you feel like they were doing it in an unusual or impossible way, like through hidden technology or powers, or was it more like regular people paying close attention?

It felt more like regular people paying too much attention, I guess. Like the other home-care agency and some people at the library were watching my paintings, and my client papers… trying to take some chance that was supposed to be mine. People told me that didn’t make sense, but I still felt like I knew they were doing it.

Do you feel like these people watching your work were trying to do something specific, like steal your ideas or interfere with your plans, and did this feel like something that could happen in real life or did it seem more unusual or unlikely?

Yeah… I thought they were trying to steal something from me. Like a chance that was supposed to be mine, through my paintings or the client papers. I know people said it didn’t make sense, but at the time it felt real to me… like they really were doing it.
Have these feelings that people were stealing your ideas or chances ever occurred while you were feeling especially high, overly confident, or energetic, or while you were deeply depressed?

Yes… when I was barely sleeping, just a few hours, and I had all those big plans with my art and the care work, that’s when it was happening too. I’d be in the studio hearing the voices, and I felt sure people were watching what I was doing.
Were there times when you experienced the voices or the feeling of being watched that were completely separate from any periods where you were feeling very high, low, or emotionally upset?

Yeah… there were times like that. After I wasn’t so wound up anymore, when my energy went down and I was sleeping more normal, it still didn’t really stop. The voices, and feeling like people were judging me or keeping track of my work… that went on for weeks.
Can you tell me if the voices or the feeling of being watched lasted for more than a month in total, even when your mood was stable and you weren’t feeling unusually high or low?
Yeah… I think it did. After I wasn’t so worked up and was sleeping more normal, it still went on for several weeks… the voices and feeling like people were judging or keeping track of my work.
Were the voices or the feeling of being watched present even during times when you were not feeling especially high, low, or emotionally upset?
Yeah… even after I wasn’t so high energy anymore, and I was sleeping more normal, it kept going. The voices and that feeling like people were judging me or tracking my work… it went on for weeks.
